subject.title: fix(xai): apply request policy to video generation requests

question: Should xAI video polling and generated-video downloads now fail closed by default, with private-network access permitted only through the existing explicit xAI provider request policy?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically sound, but this intentionally replaces a shipped unguarded fallback and can stop private, proxy, or fake-IP deployments until operators opt in; only maintainers can confirm that security-versus-compatibility choice.

options.title: Approve Default-Deny Guarding
options.body: Accept the safer default and document or release-note that private xAI video routes must explicitly enable the existing provider request policy.

options.title: Narrow Download Trust
options.body: Keep guarded polling but revise the patch so private-network permission does not automatically extend to provider-returned download URLs without a separate trusted rule.

options.title: Preserve Shipped Compatibility
options.body: Retain the old unguarded behavior for existing users, accepting the SSRF exposure until a separately sponsored migration or strict-mode design exists.

recommendation.title: Approve Default-Deny Guarding
recommendation.body: Accept the safer default and document or release-note that private xAI video routes must explicitly enable the existing provider request policy.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision concerns the semantics and upgrade contract of the provider request-policy system most closely associated with this history.
